title: UN/LOCODE 地点コード — 日本（港湾・空港・ターミナル）
description: 日本のすべての UN/LOCODE 地点コードの一覧. All 2,170 UN/LOCODE entries for Japan from the UNECE United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations: LOCODE, place name (with and without diacritics), subdivision, function classifiers (sea port, rail, road, airport, postal, multimodal), approval status, IATA code and coordinates. Function legend embedded per record; status codes per UNECE status-indicators table.
